judged_text: Organizer lookup crashes for bookings with userId null, throwing raw Prisma error as unhandled 500

record.issue_text: Organizer lookup crashes for bookings with userId null, throwing raw Prisma error as unhandled 500

adjudication.rationale: In the new `addGuestsHandler`, the organizer is fetched with `prisma.user.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { id: booking.userId || 0 } })`. If `booking.userId` is `null`, this coerces to `0`, which will not match a real user and will cause `findFirstOrThrow` to throw (not converted into a `TRPCError`). There is no guard for `booking.userId == null`, so this can crash the mutation for such bookings and surface as a 500.
